## Overview

The Seafood category collects the 6 product pages the Heavy Metal Index tracks in this part of the food supply. Each linked page summarizes what the peer-reviewed and regulatory literature reports for heavy-metal occurrence in that product form, with per-claim citations to the underlying source pages.
